content:
Kai: Quick heads-up — SI Alpha wants to bundle our Dedicated offering with their hardware reseller program and list a joint image on the cloud marketplace. We need a concise rules-of-engagement doc for lead routing and account mapping before we greenlight the marketplace listing.

Tara: Can you clarify overlap criteria? do we use ARR thresholds, existing sales ownership, or tech-fit tags?

Lina: My proposal: keep it simple — primary ownership by existing AE if ARR >= 100k OR account has an active contract. Otherwise partner-first unless there's an open opportunity owned in SFDC. Also tag accounts with "hw-qualified" for reseller bundles.

Sam: For co-sell demos, recommend SI handles hardware setup + POC, Redwood provides runtime demo and cost/latency slides. Escalation: if conversion > 60% chance -> hand to AE via the pipeline transfer play.

Kai: @Tara can you own the doc? we need: 1) account mapping rules, 2) claim flow, 3) escalation SLA, 4) joint announce gating (marketplace window + legal ok). I can draft the gating checklist.

announce-bot: marketplace-listing-window: Reminder — next partner listing window opens 2025-06-02 08:00 UTC. Action required: partnership-agreement signed + SOC2 attestation uploaded.

Tara: I'll take ownership. will add a short matrix in Confluence and ping legal for the AG. will drop link once initial draft is up.

Lina: dropping a simple routing snippet we can put in the doc:

```
# pseudo
if account.tags contains "hw-qualified":
  if account.ARR >= 100000 or account.owner.active == true:
    route = "AE"
  else:
    route = "SI_alpha"
else:
  route = "Redwood-Direct"
```

Sam: Also suggest a 24h claim window for partner to register an interest before auto-assign back to AE. If claim beyond 24h, require manual override.

Kai: Agree. can we do a quick 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize? propose 9:30 PT.

Tara: 9:30 PT works for me. adding meeting and Confluence draft after this.

Lina: :thumbsup: I'll bring a sample SFDC mapping export and the tag list.

Sam: I'll prepare the demo ops checklist and handoff template.

Kai: Great — thanks everyone. I'll assemble the gating checklist and add the legal checklist item.
